title: bumelia americana subsp. neglecta
intro: Bumelia americana subsp. neglecta, commonly known as Texas bumelia, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Texas bumelia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, anti-ulcerogenic, and hepatoprotective effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising candidate for the development of new medicinal products.
